hero.headline: The Complete Digital Marketing Platform for Your Clients' Total Online Success
hero.description: When growing small businesses are ready to stop piecing together tools, they need one platform that does it all. Hostopia's white-label Marketing 360 Suite combines AI-driven SEO, Google Ads, local listings, reputation, social, and competitive intelligence in a single product — giving your customers enterprise-grade marketing power with small-business simplicity.

features.heading: Complete Digital Marketing Execution, Every Tool, One Platform
features.intro: Everything businesses need to be found, trusted, and chosen — managed from a single platform. Marketing 360 combines every capability in the Hostopia portfolio into the most comprehensive marketing solution you can offer.

cards.title: Complete SEO Mastery
cards.body: Full AI-driven SEO, automated weekly tasks, keyword research, backlink and off-page optimization — everything customers need for sustained organic growth, without the noise of enterprise tools.

cards.title: Local Visibility at Scale
cards.body: Sync and manage business profiles across 3,000+ directories with real-time updates and visibility tracking. Ensure customers are searchable everywhere buyers look.

cards.title: Social & Advertising Activation
cards.body: Plan, publish, and promote content across major social platforms, with full Google Ads management — AI-powered campaigns, smart budget controls, and continuous optimization built in.

cards.title: Reputation & Trust Management
cards.body: Generate reviews, automate on-brand responses across platforms, and track sentiment. A meaningful contributor to overall revenue growth, built directly into the suite.

cards.title: Competitive & Brand Intelligence
cards.body: Track rankings, mentions, ads, and competitors with real-time alerts. Turn market movement into actionable insight every week.

cards.title: Unified, AI-Powered Platform
cards.body: Manage all marketing activity from one dashboard with integrated analytics, automation, and mobile access. One suite. One story. One bill.

partnerAdvantage.heading: Your Premium Revenue Stream — Maximum Value, Maximum Retention
partnerAdvantage.intro: Marketing 360 is the pinnacle of your digital marketing portfolio. It generates the highest revenue per customer, creates the deepest product dependency, and positions your brand as a complete marketing solution.

items.title: Premium revenue stream offering
items.body: Marketing 360 is the highest-subscription-price product in your digital marketing portfolio. The comprehensive feature set justifies premium pricing while delivering clear value — making it your highest ARPU digital product and a meaningful contributor to overall revenue growth.

items.title: Maximum differentiation in the market
items.body: No other white-label partner delivers a fully integrated marketing suite at this depth. AI-driven SEO, advertising, reputation, listings, and 3,000+ directory syncing — all under one platform, under your brand. That combination is a market-position competitors can't replicate cheaply.

items.title: Ultimate retention through comprehensive dependency
items.body: When an SMB uses every function in Marketing 360 — SEO, ads, social, reputation, listings, competitive tracking — switching cost becomes enormous. Suite 360 creates the deepest product dependency in your portfolio, driving the lowest churn rates.

items.title: Complete marketing solution that replaces point tools
items.body: SMBs using 4-6 separate marketing tools can consolidate everything into Suite 360 under your brand. You capture spend that currently goes to standalone SEO tools, review platforms, ad managers, and social schedulers — bringing it all into your recurring revenue.

lifecycleFit.heading: The Complete Marketing Stack — For Businesses Ready to Dominate
lifecycleFit.intro: Marketing 360 sits at the top of your digital marketing portfolio. It's for SMBs who have outgrown individual tools and need a unified platform that manages every aspect of their digital marketing.

steps.title: Build a Brand

steps.title: Get Online
steps.body: Websites, hosting, listings, and social presence create the digital foundation.

steps.body: Marketing 360 adds every marketing tool full-time success needs: SEO, advertising, reputation, listings, and intelligence — all in one AI-powered suite.
